preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(R, int) and isinstance(C, int) and isinstance(X, int) and 2 <= R <= 1000 and 2 <= C <= 1000 and 2 <= X <= min(R, C) for R, C, X in test_cases_params)
preconditions.description: For each test case, R, C, and X are integers satisfying the constraints 2 <= R, C <= 1000 and 2 <= X <= min(R, C).

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(val, int) and abs(val) <= 10**9 for val in row) for row in A) and all(all(isinstance(val, int) and abs(val) <= 10**9 for val in row) for row in B)
preconditions.description: All elements in matrices A and B are integers with absolute values not exceeding 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(A) == R and all(len(row) == C for row in A) and len(B) == R and all(len(row) == C for row in B)
preconditions.description: Matrices A and B both have exactly R rows and C columns.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ['Yes', 'No'] for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: all((line == 'Yes') == (can_transform(A, B, R, C, X)) for line, (A, B, R, C, X) in zip(stdout_lines, test_cases_data))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'Yes' if and only if matrix A can be transformed into matrix B using the allowed operations, and 'No' otherwise. The transformation is possible if and only if the difference matrix D = B - A satisfies the condition that for every 2x2 subgrid of D, the alternating sum D[i][j] - D[i][j+1] - D[i+1][j] + D[i+1][j+1] is divisible by X, and this condition holds for all valid i, j.
